failures.evidence: Only hide overlaps; unavailable/back-order is not linked to out-of-stock/inventory.
Only delivered overlaps; rating/rate and purchase/purchaser do not normalize together.
Tracking overlaps, but parcel/leaves warehouse is not linked to shipment/shipped.
Text buyer is not linked to order notification/email; conjunction is the sole overlap.
Register/every buyer has no lexical bridge to registered customer authentication.
Anonymous purchasing has no lexical bridge to guest checkout.
Document domain plus task match scores highly, but one direct term and no title overlap fail the gate.
Correct API requirement is eligible but three broad project/task distractors rank above it.
Signed callback/customer URL is not linked to webhook; only task overlaps.
Uploaded document maps to document domain but file/attachment wording does not directly match.
Searching does not normalize to search; only task overlaps.

dominant_findings: Eight of eleven missed targets fail the threshold, two fail the specific-match gate, and one is excluded by top-k competition.
The dominant root cause is representation/normalization coverage, not numeric threshold choice alone.
Blindly lowering threshold would increase false exposure and would not fix zero-score paraphrases or the specific-match gate.
